set.body:
Why: Decompositions.Pca, Decompositions.Svd, GenPca.identityFit (labelled "identity-svd", comment "exactly the Pca/Svd path, adapted into GMD factors", GenPca.scala:275,300), and CPCA whitened SVD are parallel routines. Decompositions.Pca is an independent whiten/decompose/assemble pipeline (Decompositions.scala:26-35,237-265) rather than GenPca.fit(identity, identity).

Scope: define Pca.fit in terms of the GenPca identity backend (already a direct fast SVD); keep Svd as the pass-preprocessing variant; reconcile the result surfaces (needs the unified LatentFit).

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Decompositions.Pca no longer contains an independent whiten/decompose/assemble pipeline; it routes through the GenPca identity backend.
- [ ] No behavioral change: GenPCA R-reference fixtures and PcaFit consumers assert identical outputs.
- [ ] JVM+JS green.
Depends on the unified-LatentFit item.
set.title: multivar: single PCA path — define Pca via the GenPca identity backend
